cio_brief.ai: Good morning, Raj. Before the care team starts outreach, one thing needs your attention: the impactability model failed its subgroup check.
points: Frontier ZIPs rank {{ constants.MODEL.frontierGapPct | pct }} lower than similar town members; {{ constants.MODEL.missingFromTop }} high-need frontier members miss the top {{ constants.COHORT.topRanked }}.

asks: Did the risk model pass its subgroup check?
cio_subgroup.ai: The model uses past utilization as a main input, so frontier members are ranked lower in every condition group.
points: Frontier members have {{ constants.MODEL.fewerVisitsPct | pct }} fewer primary care visits: a {{ constants.MODEL.medianDriveMin }}-minute median drive, and {{ constants.MODEL.noBroadband }} have no broadband.
Fewer visits mean fewer claims, which the model reads as lower risk.
Same conditions and labs, ranked lower in every group: the known cost-as-proxy bias.
